scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/hail-codec-ts build && bun run --filter 'hail-*' build
scripts.test: bun run test:workspaces && bun run test:go
scripts.test:workspaces: bun run --cwd packages/hail-codec-ts build && bun run --filter '*' test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/hail-codec-ts build && bun run --filter '*' typecheck
scripts.test:cli: bun run --cwd apps/cli test && bun run --cwd apps/cli test:workflows
